Message:
I wrapped Elaine in
the warmth of my embrace,
arms clasped together
as if in prayer.

Hope, joy, love...
Her heart was
filled to the brim with
such beautiful light.

Elaine truly loves the Hero,
with all of her heart.

So much so, that there isn’t
the smallest crack for
a demon to slip into.

Tears wouldn’t stop pouring from
my eyes. My power couldn’t even
hurt a fly—it could only drive out
demons from one’s heart.

But, against a heart already
filled with the desire to save
someone precious...
I couldn’t do anything.

As I hung
my head in defeat,
I felt Elaine gently
hug me back...
as if to comfort me.
“That is just about all you can do.”

So, you’ll always be frozen—
unable to take that
final step forward.”

Elaine’s spirit shone brightly,
as if polished to a pristine white.

Almost like every trace of doubt
she’d once held
had been wiped clean.

Elaine just looked at me
and smiled.
The same smile as always.

“I can save him.
Leave everything to me.”
